messages.content: One HTML file for an overnight radio desk. Night glass, acid cyan type, one magenta alarm word, tiny monospace labels. Show 3.

[frame: pathway=s2|mode=code|construct=coder|persona=neutral|identity=none|theme=none|channel=reasoning] The ground is almost black so the cyan reads as a lamp, not as a link blue. Magenta is only the alarm word, or the whole screen becomes a poster. Labels are small, uppercase, tracked out, so they feel like chassis print. 3 is the open mics. A focus ring in magenta keeps the keyboard path visible against the cyan border. Desk
